title: New Year message from the ATTP President
excerpt: New Year message from the ATTP President
body_html:
Dear players, coaches and members of the table tennis community of the Republic of Moldova,

On the eve of the New Year, our thoughts naturally turn to the road we have travelled and to the meaning of the work we have done together. 2025 strengthened a direction built on perseverance, discipline and respect for the sport and its athletes.

Our competitive results, the growth of the professional circuit and qualification for the 2026 World Championships confirm that there is real potential here and a community capable of sustaining performance over the long term.

2026 opens as a year of responsibility and continuity. It will demand rigour, balance and the ability to stay true to the principles that give performance sport its stability.

I wish you health, inner strength and clarity in your decisions. May everyone’s work be rewarded with progress, mutual respect and results that speak for themselves. Let us move forward with confidence and dignity, aware of the value of the path we have chosen.

Happy New Year — may 2026 be full of meaning and achievement!

Rostislav Sobiețki

ATTP President
